@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+Comparable version info in ``matplotlib.__version_info__``
+~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
+
+In addition to the version string ``matplotlib.__version__``,
+`matplotlib.__version_info__` is a namedtuple, modelled after `sys.version_info`,
+that can more reliably be used to check the version of Matplotlib installed,
+e.g. ``matplotlib.__version_info__ >= (3, 5)``.
